title: DeLonge in secure facilities

tellings.quote: I have been in secure facilities, you know, the codes and the alarms and the guns and all that shit to get into there and they lock you in and they're airtight

plain: A guest named Tom DeLonge says that in the 2010s he went inside secret, high-security government buildings. He describes it from his own experience: the codes, the alarms and the armed guards to get in, and rooms that lock you inside and are sealed airtight. He tells it to show how close he got to the people who keep secrets on this subject.
